confidence_notes: Food anchors use current aggregated Honolulu prices (Numbeo last updated 2026-10-15). Cocktail and wine-glass anchors are estimates from local draft-beer pricing because representative typical-price observations were limited. Accommodation anchors are broad model estimates without live listing checks and are especially uncertain because of season and Waikiki location.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food anchors rely on direct Honolulu prices, while accommodation anchors reflect a high-cost US island destination.
